entities.summary: Illyrian, a notable figure in the history of Albania, associated with Illyrian Tribes and Ancient Albania (229 BCE–168 BCE). Preceded by Illyrian Tribal Kingdoms. Their legacy influenced Defeat of King Gentius and end of Illyrian independence and First Illyrian War against Queen Teuta.
